arguments.description: Creates the same native type=stroke document object used by interactive drawing. Natural kinds brush/drybrush/airbrush are routed to the existing natural-v2 renderer.

kind.description: Existing native stroke kind. Blender, Smudge, and Eraser are intentionally excluded from A2.

objectId.description: Optional caller-supplied stable stroke object id; collisions are rejected.

samples.description: World-space samples; at least two are required.

paperFingerprint.description: Expected active-page paper fingerprint; captured automatically for page.paper.set.v1.

revisionId.description: Expected revision id; omit when not constraining revision.
